dashboard-desc: Hey there! I'm Alice. I spend most of my time exploring these lands and meeting fellow adventurers. Whether you're here to sharpen your gear or uncover new items, I've put together this website to help you find your way through Winds of Valen.
hero-count-desc: This live count is fetched directly from the Steam Web API for App ID 4135880.
disc-desc: Get live announcements, report community bugs, view patch notes, and chat with devs.
steam-desc: Check recent official updates, download or purchase the game client directly on Steam.
nav-chk-d: New to Winds of Valen ? Follow this step-by-step progression guide to know what to do first.
nav-bot-d: I have the full wiki in my memory. Ask me anything wiki related! I am your search encyclopedia for items recipes and more.
nav-eq-d: Plan your perfect build! Test gear sets and see your final stats.
nav-vid-d: Watch/upload gameplay tips, Guides,Combat Info, Showcases and Walkthroughs for Winds of Valen.
nav-com-d: Try your gear switching skills with this combat practice engine. Keybinding included!
